source: runtime capture (SkyZH), mining and Glacite Mineshaft chat

messages.context: 每日首次挖掘某种矿物的粉末奖励
messages.raw: §9᠅ §fYou've earned §d%1$s %2$s Powder §ffrom mining your first %3$s of the day!
messages.text: ᠅ You've earned %1$s %2$s Powder from mining your first %3$s of the day!
messages.gloss: 首挖奖励随材料和数值变化；粉末与资源分别查词表，不能按某次掉落枚举。
messages.zh: ᠅ 你今天首次挖到%3$s，获得了 %1$s %2$s粉末!

messages.context: 滚动矿工效果给予双倍掉落
messages.text: Rolling miner granted you double drops!
messages.gloss: 滚动矿工为效果名称，非玩家名。
messages.zh: 滚动矿工让你获得了双倍掉落!

messages.text: Your armadillo is full of energy!
